limits.flow_geometry_is_2d_projection: the whole internet is flowed in the PCA(2) projection of its real 128D embeddings (~11% of variance); the 128D native space is the routing/embedding space (T55i) and its flow stays near 10^4 (crease #22)
limits.one_machine: this is still one 31.7 GB box (T20/T67); a true distributed flow across machines remains unbuilt
limits.sequential_flow: flow keeps its Gauss-Seidel per-neuron loop (identical to T67; a vectorized Jacobi update would change the dynamics)
